meta.title: Massachusetts ESOPs — Form 5500
meta.source: U.S. Department of Labor, EFAST2 Form 5500 bulk datasets

bases.active: Plans reporting at least one active participant, minus a short list of known defunct/wind-down plans. Use for 'how many working MA ESOPs' and for every per-plan average.
bases.filed: Every ESOP that filed a Form 5500 for the year, including plans winding down. Use for year-over-year trend lines.

caveats: total_participants is the plan total at the END of the plan year (Form 5500 line 6f: current employees, retirees, former employees still owed a balance, beneficiaries); active_participants is current employees on the same date (line 6a).
employer_securities (company stock) is Schedule H line 1d(1) for large plans and Schedule I line 3d for small plans. null means the plan left the line blank, which is not the same as zero.
Every dollar figure is the end-of-plan-year value from the plan's own Schedule H or I, as filed.
A form year keeps growing for roughly 18 months as fiscal-year and extended filers arrive, so the most recent year is not final.
Every ESOP of a Massachusetts-based employer is counted, closely held or publicly traded. 401(k)/savings plans that merely offer employer stock are not ESOPs and are excluded.
